notes.title: Poltergeist: A Pixelated Horror - Launch announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Poltergeist: A Pixelated Horror will launch on October 21st 2014 via Steam for $7.99! It will work on PC/Mac/Linux.
It will also be released on PS Vita next week on October 28th 2014.

If you add the game to your Steam Wishlist, you will be notified when the game is available.

Get ready to scare!

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/19843771/Polter_Blog/PosterPolter_BOXSHOT_small.png[/img]
